data_plan.class_mapping: original source classes1..4 map to0..3; all other DBpedia classes excluded after graph closure
data_plan.components: union equal normalized title,body,full input or truncated input across all official splits and both complete corpora
data_plan.evaluation_labels: AES-256-GCM payloads; evaluator-owned key; authenticated protocol/task/access/plaintext hashes
data_plan.limits: exact normalized identity exclusion; semantic paraphrase overlap and foundation pretraining exposure unknown
data_plan.normalization: NFKC,casefold,Unicode word tokens,collapsed whitespace; source-only identity matching
data_plan.selection: stable salted component SHA order; disjoint balanced roles; no retries or outcome-based resampling
data_plan.split: official test supplies future; official train components partition old/current by fixed SHA parity
data_plan.text: original CSV title + newline + description/content; deterministic first6000characters

development.selection: lexicographic: candidate incomplete count, groups with old validation regression, groups CPU>3, mean paired current-validation difference vs H1; all V4 labels are development
development.source: previously disclosed V4 UCI/20NG validation; no V5 features/outcomes before freeze

evaluation.bootstrap_method: class-stratified source-component percentile; per-example seed average; higher quantile
evaluation.cpu_aggregation: sum over three paired seeds per task/head
evaluation.cpu_scope: own response construction, solver, all prospective trials and committed transitions; identical output/evaluation I/O separately reported
evaluation.independent_old_path: report old-test NLL maximum excess across all actually committed states descriptively; primary retention gate remains terminal vs warmup
evaluation.stopped_policy_scoring: retain actual terminal predictions and count stops; only declared required policies block completion gate; all actual execution errors/missing/nonfinite outputs block acceptance

fixed_library.independence: same preexisting SHA256 sign library; no learned/optimized directions and no reseeding
fixed_library.physical_action: one first post-Adam dt*u; zero suffix; abs(u_j)<=1/sqrt(p)

fixed_scoring.scope: unchanged V4 scoring for matched direction/amplitude mechanism diagnosis; V5 policy objective separately declared

label_access: encrypted validation/final labels and evaluator-owned key; in-memory decryption only after complete protocol/code/prediction seal; controller open audit denies withheld payload names

mpc.cost: own response construction, solver, all prospective trials and committed transitions; identical output/evaluation I/O separately reported
mpc.replan: H1 every step; H8 optimize and commit frozen eight-action block, four blocks total
mpc.scope: analytic complete-state coefficients; two terminal action-response rows; no autonomous compact observer claim

pressure.failures: retain all infeasible/unresolved/rejected conditions; rejected zero is not advanced
pressure.threshold: original warmup old-probe NLL; no slack
pressure.verification: all future steps1..8; initial excess separately recorded; no retrospective safe-past claim

projection.method: Gaussian QR; diagonal R sign fixed; label-independent

publication_scope: additive code, main detailed report and compact evidence on GitHub; raw corpora/large arrays remain local; preserve all V4 results
registration: remote protocol before new cohort feature extraction/model outcomes; not independent preregistration

response.all_directions_preserved: spectral residual multiplied by action norm; no action-family restriction
response.derivative: analytic weighted CE Hessian products and exact Adam JVP/VJP in smooth regime; explicit failure at clips
response.scope: SVD statistic of complete-state local finite-window impulse map; all49 actions remain available
